The field journals now run in the order they happened: Coyote Creation, then The Fledging of Downy Woodpeckers ("Skipping coyotes this morning in case downies fledge"), then Coyote Tales ("Downy woodpeckers fledged, so back to seeing the coyotes").

arcs.label: The world's harshness and the self

ordering_notes: The Yeshu cluster follows the church year: Christmas, then Palm Sunday, then the empty tomb (Do Not Cling to the Light), then the Lamb (Powerless Triumph).

structure-of-the-purpose-and-destiny-of-.label: Foundation – Purpose – Meaning – Destiny
structure-of-the-purpose-and-destiny-of-.blurb: The architecture underneath it all — why we're here, and where it's going.
structure-of-the-purpose-and-destiny-of-.lede: This physical life is after all merely a parable, a corporeal telling of a tale with meanings disguised, a momentary riddle condensing truths eternal. Thirty-four essays and poems, moving from small scenes in Nature and the shape of a single life, through the structure beneath it — Choice, consciousness, and why this world holds so much madness — toward the place of Light that awaits.
structure-of-the-purpose-and-destiny-of-.meta_description: Thirty-four essays and poems by Don Ray tracing the architecture underneath it all — why we're here, and where it's going.
structure-of-the-purpose-and-destiny-of-.og_description: Thirty-four essays and poems by Don Ray tracing the architecture underneath it all — why we're here, and where it's going.

arcs.label: Why this world: the Garden, madness, and Love

ordering_notes: The framework now comes before the pieces that rely on it. Our Actions ("The structure of existence … it is all right before us") lays out survival, connection and chosen Love before Dark Matter and The Inevitable and the Certain build on "the Choice".
The Garden trilogy: Knowledge of Good and Evil, then Would We Miss Death ("Would we eat the Fruit in the Garden again?"), then Terrifying Passage, which answers it.

The overture pieces become conclusions. Three Principles ("Were we to boil everything down … You are not alone") and Currency of the Soul ("Patience and faith are the currency of the soul") now distill the living section instead of opening the category.
The two destiny poems close it. Shadow Embrace ("perfection hidden for now") is followed by Overlapping Projections of Gods ("In that place of Light …").
